    private static final class Cells {
        static final byte[] DATA=build();
        static byte[] build(){
            byte[] data=new byte[WIDTH*HEIGHT*DEPTH];
            for(int[] b:BOXES)for(int y=b[1];y<=b[4];y++)for(int z=b[2];z<=b[5];z++)
                for(int x=b[0];x<=b[3];x++)data[x+z*WIDTH+y*WIDTH*DEPTH]=(byte)b[6];
            return data;
        }
    }
    private static final class Palette {
        static final BlockState[] STATES={null,Blocks.AIR.defaultBlockState(),DungeonMasonryBlock.finish(0),DungeonMasonryBlock.finish(2),Blocks.DARK_OAK_PLANKS.defaultBlockState(),DungeonMasonryBlock.finish(1),Blocks.RED_NETHER_BRICKS.defaultBlockState(),Blocks.PEARLESCENT_FROGLIGHT.defaultBlockState(),Blocks.WATER.defaultBlockState(),Blocks.CHAIN.defaultBlockState(),Blocks.IRON_BARS.defaultBlockState()};
    }
    public static BlockState cell(int x,int y,int z){
        if(x<0||x>=WIDTH||y<0||y>=HEIGHT||z<0||z>=DEPTH)return null;
        return Palette.STATES[Byte.toUnsignedInt(Cells.DATA[x+z*WIDTH+y*WIDTH*DEPTH])];
    }
    private WangsiArchitecture(){}
